# CANDIDATE: SHOTGUN_SCALPER_STAGE3_TOP_KEEPER

## Hypothesis

We are trying to capture edge by optimizing take-profit, stop-loss, time stop, strike offset, chandelier arm, and volume ratio parameters. The edge exists because default parameters may not align with the structural conditions of J's winner days while avoiding excessive losses on loser days.

## Mechanism

- Entry triggered when volume ratio >= 1.0 (current volume at least 20-bar average)
- Strike selected at ATM + 2 (OTM-2) offset
- Take-profit at 1.5x entry premium (+50% gain)
- Stop-loss at -0.35x entry premium (-35% loss)
- Time stop at 15 minutes
- Chandelier profit-lock arms at 0.5x entry premium (+50% gain) and trails 0.15x from high-water mark
